rules.rule: Use correct service and method names matching the device and action precisely.
Use exact numeric values or standard numeric formats for parameters, avoid enums or color names.
Use exact device group selectors including location tags when specified
Use canonical service and receiver names from the domain ontology
Use exact numeric units and convert units to base units when applicable
Use exact service and receiver names from input context without generic substitutions
Fully qualify service calls with receiver and service names; do not simplify or omit numeric constants.
Include all relevant receivers and services explicitly in the script
